verdict.line: You lose if Jax lands a leap-empower combo while your E (Skip 'n Slash) is down; you win by denying his all-in windows and outscaling through Dusk and Dawn and Shadowflame.

brief.thesis: Jax's threat is burst timing, not sustained damage: Q (Leap Strike) closing with W (Empower) loaded is the only window he kills you in. Gwen's Q (Snip Snip!) deals true damage in its center hit, which is not a basic attack, so Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodging autos does nothing to stop it — bait his E, then land Q for free.

theirWindow.when: W (Empower) glowing and Q (Leap Strike) ready
theirWindow.what: He can leap, empower-auto, and follow with Relentless Assault stacks for a fast burst. Back off to max Q range or drop W (Hallowed Mist) so he has to commit into the mist to reach you.

yourWindow.when: Jax's E (Counter Strike) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: All-in with E (Skip 'n Slash) into Q — he has no stun to punish the engage, and even if he pops E later your Q's true-damage center hit still lands since it isn't a basic attack.

powerCurve.note: Q leap-ins punish you before your E exists
E (Skip 'n Slash) lets you trade and disengage
Relentless Assault extends trades he wins
R (Needlework) adds poke, items narrow the gap
Shadowflame and Rabadon's outscale his duels

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The 91.3%-pick start on this matchup; the extra potion covers the poke you'll eat from Q leap trades while you lack E.

boots.why: Jax's damage is almost entirely basic attacks (Empower, Relentless Assault stacks) — flat reduction blunts his all-in harder than Mercury's Treads does here.

core.why: First item in the highest-winrate path (66.7% over the sampled games) and gives the early burst you need to punish his cooldown gaps.
Second item in that same path; spikes your Q and E burst right as his Relentless Assault window gets scarier.
Closes out the build order that posted 66.7% in the sample — this is where Gwen's late-game edge over Jax actually shows up.

situational.when: jax is building tanky and you need attack speed to keep E's on-hit damage relevant
the game goes long and you need sustain in extended side-lane fights

runes.keystoneWhy: You need to win extended trades, not just burst ones — Conqueror's ramping damage and adaptive healing stacks exactly during the E-into-Q-into-auto sequences you're using to out-trade him.

summoners.why: Flash/Ignite is run in 87% of games here and lets you close out the all-ins you win; Flash/Teleport (8.7% pick, 50% win rate) is the alternative if you expect a longer, less kill-focused lane.

playing.title: Bait Counter Strike before trading
playing.detail: Jax's E (Counter Strike) only dodges basic attacks. Throw out a Q (Snip Snip!) first — if he pops E to dodge, land the true-damage center hit anyway and follow with autos once his stance ends.

playing.title: Track Q (Leap Strike) cooldown, not just distance
playing.detail: Leap Strike's cooldown drops from 17s at rank 1 to 5s at rank 5 — by mid-game he can reset the leap almost every trade. Don't assume one dodged leap buys you a long window.

playing.title: Drop W (Hallowed Mist) before he commits
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist only lets enemies target you once they enter it. Pre-place it when he's loading Empower so his leap-in forces him to walk into your zone, not the other way around.

playing.title: Chain E into Q for the reset
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash's cooldown partially refunds if you hit an enemy during its attack-speed window. Dash in, auto, then Q — a connected hit gets your dash back faster than its base 13-11s cooldown.

playing.title: Don't extended-trade after level 6
playing.detail: Relentless Assault gives Jax free attack speed on consecutive hits with bonus damage every third strike. Once he's stacking it, disengage with E rather than standing in prolonged auto exchanges.

playing.title: Save R (Needlework) ranks for poke, not kill threat
playing.detail: Needlework starts at a 120s cooldown at rank 1, far too slow to rely on in lane. Once it's ranked up its cooldown drops sharply — use it to zone his approach rather than expecting an early execute.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 51% overall win rate with Jax holding lane and solo-kill advantage are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the timing reads on Counter Strike, Leap Strike cooldowns, and the Hallowed Mist interaction are our tactical judgment, not measured data.
